Messages.Author: lovre
Messages.Body:
Master Regent states that sabbat vampires may enter combat with this
vampire as a D-action. Does the same apply to vampires which have the
regent title by default? (Sha-Ennu)

Was wondering, because it seems kind of stupid if I, say, contest my
title with Sha-Ennu via a master card, and supposedly I win, everyone
playing a sabbat clan can enter combat with me, while no one can touch
Sha-Ennu by default if the same disability does not come with the regent
title by default.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
lovre wrote:
> Master Regent states that sabbat vampires may enter combat with this
> vampire as a D-action. Does the same apply to vampires which have the
> regent title by default? (Sha-Ennu)

No. Similarly, Praxis Seizure: Paris says that if the prince is a
Toreador, his capacity is increased, but the existence of that card
doesn't mean Francois Villon's capacity is 11 while he remains Prince
of Paris.

> Was wondering, because it seems kind of stupid if I, say, contest my
> title with Sha-Ennu via a master card, and supposedly I win, everyone
> playing a sabbat clan can enter combat with me, while no one can touch
> Sha-Ennu by default if the same disability does not come with the regent
> title by default.

Not silly. Just card text.

Messages.Body:

> Not silly. Just card text.

Ok, which sabbat title required cards can a regent play? Like, cardinal,
archbishop, bishop, prisci, or what?

THANK YOU :*

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The ones that require a regent and the ones that require a cardinal.

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:


All cards that require a Cardinal or a Regent can be played by a
Regent. At this time, that's any card that requires a Sabbat title.

--
- Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
